POSITION(Vertical Display Position Control) Use this control for moving the picture horizontally onto the desired position. Screen-Size-Changing Chip There are two chips; "NARROW" (Standard Size) and "WIDE" (Larger Size). Normally, set to the “NARROW". Screen-Inversion Connectors There are two connectors; "NORMAL"(Standard) and “REVERSE" (Screen-Inversion). Normally, set to the “NORMAL". FOCUS(Focus Control) Use this control for adjusting the screen focus. SCREEN This is to be set to the “cut-off" point. Normally, this control is not used.
